integrity: Exact integer and Fraction arithmetic with two finite graph decomposition algorithms are embedded and reproduced. Source date is the public preprint version of the motivating low-precision study, while explicit bfloat16 logistic diagrams appear in its 2023 expanded publication. Independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns exactly two specified bfloat16 maps at logistic parameter four on 16257 nonnegative encoded states. Enumeration is exhaustive only for this finite set, not a real-state or other-format theorem. The counting distribution is uniform over encodings and no compiler operation order is inferred.
title: Exact bfloat16 logistic basin inversion under a single intermediate rounding
